describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal equine shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. It has a stocky donkey-like body with a brownish-gray shaggy coat that is lighter on the belly and muzzle, a short upright mane along the neck, large upright ears, and a thin tail with a dark tuft. Faint to moderate dark striping is visible across the torso, hindquarters, neck, and lower legs, and the animal stands on four slender legs ending in single hooves.

describe.description: The creature is a slender four-legged equid shown in right-facing profile with a donkey-like build. It has a long narrow head with a pale muzzle, large upright ears, a short erect striped mane along its neck, and a thin tufted tail. Its coat is shaggy brown-gray with a white belly and muzzle, marked with a dark stripe along the back and over the shoulders and with faint dark zebra-like stripes on the torso, neck, and legs. It stands on four long thin legs ending in dark single hooves.
